page_title: BHA 2-2 NOT | Brighton v Nottingham Forest 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+6' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Yankuba Minteh (Brighton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+5' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Matz Sels easily deals with the threat. Now Brighton have a corner.
90+5' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
90+4' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+3' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) attempts to find Danny Welbeck, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
89' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is about to take a corner kick.
86' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' Fabian Hurzeler is stunned as referee Robert Jones shows him a RED CARD.
83' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Nuno Espirito Santo, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!

83' Robert Jones blows his whistle and Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
82' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Evan Ferguson (Brighton) replacing Pervis Estupinan.
79' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
78' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
77' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' Jota Silva (Nottingham) is flagged for offside.
73' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Here is a change. Chris Wood is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Morato (Nottingham).
71' It is time for a substitution. Joao Pedro (Brighton) is on for Georginio Rutter.
70' 2 - 2 Goal! Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) scores after an assist by Jota Silva that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:2.
68' Dangerous play by Danny Welbeck (Brighton). Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
66' The ball possession at the moment is 68:32.
64' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Jota Silva (Nottingham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
63' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
62' The game has come to an end for Simon Adingra. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Yankuba Minteh (Brighton).
62' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Carlos Baleba is replaced by Mats Wieffer (Brighton).
60' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elliot Anderson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ramon Sosa (Nottingham).
58' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) steps up to send the ball in.
56' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
54' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
52' Robert Jones blows his whistle. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
51' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes the corner but it's cleared.
50' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. Brighton have a corner.
49' Neat passing move from Brighton in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Neco Williams (Nottingham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Nuno Espirito Santo gives a chance to Neco Williams and Alex Moreno (Nottingham) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) comes off for Ryan Yates.
46' Nuno Espirito Santo makes a half-time substitution. Jota Silva comes on in place of Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A pass by Joel Veltman (Brighton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 1 Danny Welbeck (Brighton) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and scores a splendid goal after curling the ball over the wall and into the back of the net!
45' Brighton will take a free kick.
44' Ola Aina (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
44' Nottingham are ruled offside.

42' 1 - 1 Goal! Jan Paul van Hecke clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the top of the net. Matz Sels had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
41' A pass by Simon Adingra (Brighton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
39' A yellow card for bad language! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
38' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
35' Joel Veltman (Brighton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Jones blows for a foul.
34' 3:0 – the corner kicks stats.
32' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
31' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.

30' Pervis Estupinan bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Georginio Rutter (Brighton) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
30' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
29' Joel Veltman (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
27' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Bart Verbruggen anticipates well and smothers the ball.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carlos Baleba (Brighton) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
23' Simon Adingra (Brighton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Jones blows for a foul.
22' Brighton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
17' The foul by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) was seen by Robert Jones who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
16' It looks like Simon Adingra (Brighton) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
14' A player from Nottingham commits a rough challenge. Robert Jones blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bart Verbruggen into the bottom left corner.
13' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

11' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Jones no option but to blow his whistle. Nottingham are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!

9' Simon Adingra (Brighton) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Georginio Rutter. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
8' Joel Veltman (Brighton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
7' An attempted cross from Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is cleared.
6' The Brighton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Simon Adingra (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
2' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
1' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Brighton will take a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nottingham will kick-off.
Robert Jones got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
